text:
What I want to know

is where I am...

Where I was,

I know I will never know.

Where I am going I already know...


Where I was,

where I am going,

where I am,

I want to know,

for open upon the air,

dead, I will not know that, alive,

I am what I wanted to be.


Today I would like to see it;

not tomorrow:

Today!

translation.title: Song for the Eyes
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the urgent self-questioning and the source's difficult dead/alive turn.
